{{Top}}
'''Platoon leader''' was a rank in various militaries that indicated one was in charge of a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. [[Ton E'rau]] was a Platoon Leader on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] under control of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] in the Imperial era.<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "The [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]]" databank entry}}</ref> An [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Apocalypse Endor)|unidentified]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], as part of [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]], also served as a Platoon Leader prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="AE">{{Tales|14|Apocalypse Endor}}</ref>
